post_copy:
In the Mona Lisa Drexler Assembly Chambers on November 10th, all eleven Fairbanks planning commissioners backed a data center pause.

Their version ends June 30th, 2028 instead of December 31st, 2027. The study went from six months to ten. Four of the six added months go to the study.

The start waits on the Assembly. The mayor says a vote is likely January 14th, 2027. Adoption that day leaves about seven and a half months to write rules. Every week of delay comes out of that.

All five edits appear by line number with where the added months went and the 40,000 square foot line, then the mayor's belief that a purely government data center falls outside the pause.

What lands on the Assembly's desk first, finished rules or a request to extend the pause?

#FNSB #DataCenterPolicy #AlaskaAI
